sd15_inpaint.description: Content-aware SD 1.5 inpainting with masked-image conditioning

max.description: Original bf16 weights. Best quality. Needs ~20 GB RAM+VRAM combined; slow on small GPUs.

balanced.description: GGUF Q8, 8 steps. Practically identical to max at ~60% of the memory. Default.

fast.description: Same Q8 models (no reload), 6 steps. Slightly less detail. For drafts/throwaway.

lowmem.description: GGUF Q5. ~3 GB less RAM, but K-quants can sample slower on small GPUs. Use when RAM is tight.

noobai_vpred.description: Optional NoobAI XL V-pred 1.0 for anime/comic illustration; noncommercial model license
noobai_vpred.prompt_prefix: masterpiece, best quality, newest, highres, safe
noobai_vpred.negative_prompt: nsfw, worst quality, low quality, lowres, signature, username, logo, bad hands, mutated hands
